vectors.description: Audio Level: the low 8 bits are the RFC 6464 Section 3 octet: V=1, level 30 (-30 dBov). LOC-03 2.3.3.2 defines the value as the audio level and a voice activity indicator; with no vad attribute RFC 6464 Section 4 defaults to vad=on, so V is voice activity.

Audio Level: the low 8 bits are the RFC 6464 Section 3 octet: V=0, level 30 (-30 dBov). LOC-03 2.3.3.2 defines the value as the audio level and a voice activity indicator; with no vad attribute RFC 6464 Section 4 defaults to vad=on, so V is voice activity.

Audio Level: the low 8 bits are the RFC 6464 Section 3 octet: V=0, level 127 (-127 dBov). LOC-03 2.3.3.2 defines the value as the audio level and a voice activity indicator; with no vad attribute RFC 6464 Section 4 defaults to vad=on, so V is voice activity.

Audio Level: the low 8 bits are the RFC 6464 Section 3 octet: V=1, level 127 (-127 dBov). LOC-03 2.3.3.2 defines the value as the audio level and a voice activity indicator; with no vad attribute RFC 6464 Section 4 defaults to vad=on, so V is voice activity.

Audio Level: the low 8 bits are the RFC 6464 Section 3 octet: V=0, level 0 (0 dBov). LOC-03 2.3.3.2 defines the value as the audio level and a voice activity indicator; with no vad attribute RFC 6464 Section 4 defaults to vad=on, so V is voice activity.
Audio Level: 256 is outside the values 0x00-0xFF LOC-03 2.3.3.2 states.
vectors.error_detail: Audio Level: vi64 (1-2 bytes to encode values 0x00-0xFF)
